mr_title: fix(cdk/drag-drop): resolve helper directives with DI for proper hostDirectives support
mr_description:
Currently `CdkDrag` resolve its helper directives (e.g. handle or preview) using a content query, but that doesn't work when it's applied as a host directive, because no content is being projected.

These changes switch to having the helper directives inject the closest drag directive and register themselves manually.

expected_issues.title: Required parent injection throws when preview/placeholder is outside cdkDrag
expected_issues.description:
CdkDragPreview and CdkDragPlaceholder now inject CDK_DRAG_PARENT as required, so templates using *cdkDragPreview/*cdkDragPlaceholder outside a cdkDrag (previously a harmless no-op) now throw NullInjectorError.

Switching from a content query to DI registration changes the failure mode: before, a stray preview/placeholder template was simply ignored; now the constructor fails and breaks the whole component rendering. Existing apps (e.g. shared templates conditionally placed inside cdkDrag) break on upgrade. The injection should be optional with null-safe calls.

expected_issues.title: Registration refactor has no tests for host directives or detached templates
expected_issues.description: The helper directives switch from content queries to DI registration to support hostDirectives, but no test covers CdkDrag used as a host directive, nor preview/placeholder templates outside a cdkDrag (which now throw).
